review_focus:
Item P60.1 (#618), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P60.1 Arena and review flows on `jobs`

- Branch: `epic/p60a-jobs-arena`. Lanes: S, D, U, P. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P58.2 (it extends `jobs`, which P58.1 first serves, and follows P58.2 in the workspace chain; P58.2 brings in P58.1 and P55.3). Runs beside P59 (pair (b)).
- **Goal:** the arena page and the flow strip read `jobs`, and arena and flow commands stop resolving their tab on the App.
- **Done when:** `jobs`, first served in P58.1 with the in-flight ask-AI replies, gains the live arena runs, the review flows and their progress across actors; arena `resolve` and flow `key` take the tab from the `tabs` resource, and `arena_context` (`arena_service.rs:26`–`:40`) reads the review's `diff_hash` from the tab's AI section instead of `app.tab().ai.review` (A17); on the flag path `arena_service.rs` and `flow_service.rs` take `DesktopState` and name no `er_engine::app` type (`arena_service.rs:12`, `flow_service.rs:12`) outside their flag-off arms and tests, so their other App reads get sources too: config and effort (`arena_context`'s `app.config` `:30`, `resolve_effort` `:44` with the App's `current_ai_effort` at `:48`, flow `context`'s `app.config` and `current_ai_effort` `:24`–`:25`) from the settings actor's view and its default selection (ADR 0069, A18), the buckets (`app.tabs…er_dir()` `:31`) and `flow_key`'s tab scan and fallback (`flow_service.rs:52`–`:57`) from the registry's tab list, each listed tab's bucket being its content's `context.er_dir` when the key is loaded (a loaded tab may have left its restore mode, which moves its view bucket) and otherwise the bucket its descriptor resolves to, with no load and no App: `resolve_descriptor` (`crates/er-engine/src/tab_identity.rs:176`) and then the managed-root step `load_tab` runs (`er-service/src/effect.rs:235`–`:239`), extracted into one public er-service function that `load_tab` also calls (lane S); `flow_key`'s last fallback becomes the registry's active entry, keyed by `TabDescriptor::workspace_key` (`crates/er-engine/src/tabs_record.rs:56`), in place of `key(app)` (`:57`), and `arena_branch_ref` (`:29`) and `review_flow_inputs` (`flow_service.rs:28`) from the tab's content, with any step only the App has extracted into the always-compiled half (lane S), as 2a.1 did; the 20 arena and flow commands go through `er_send` and their reads through `er_fetch`, which retires the three `ArenaRunSnapshotWire` commands (`flow_get_run`, `arena_get`, `arena_override`); an arena run and a review flow on a remote PR tab key through `tabs`, covering #577's surviving plants 8 and 9; the startup recovery `flow_service::reconcile_on_load` (`flow_service.rs:200`, called in the flag-on block at `main.rs:1140`) takes the registry's `TabsView` and the ports in place of `&App` and recovers each listed tab's flow bucket from the descriptor-resolved bucket instead of iterating `app.tabs` (`:202`): it runs before `AppState` exists (`main.rs:1142`) and before any route, so no tab has content yet (the registry's `TabEntry` holds a key and a descriptor only, `crates/er-service/src/app_registry.rs:41`–`:45`), and its git reads are the ones `tabs::restore` already makes per tab (`tabs.rs:236`), while `arena_service::attach` (`main.rs:1139`, `arena_service.rs:238`) stays for the App's arena recovery and is deleted with it in P62.2; `App.svelte:293`'s `er://revision` listener is replaced by the `jobs` resource; the entry stops reading `review_flow`, `active_arena_run`, `arena_runs` and `background_arena_runs`.
- **Planted breaks:** an arena start that resolves the App's tab fails the held-App-mutex test; #577's plants 8 and 9 (re-applied) fail the new remote-PR-tab arena and flow tests; a progress tick that does not bump `jobs` fails; the Deep cancel and orphan test from P28b/P32b is reused unchanged; with the App locked, startup recovery recovers the review flow in the bucket of each restored tab that the registry lists and nothing has loaded; a `reconcile_on_load` that reads `app.tabs` waits on the App and fails that test (`tabs::restore` at `main.rs:1130` has already filled `app.tabs`, so a test that only counts recovered flows would pass against today's code), and a lookup that reads only loaded content recovers nothing and fails it; on a loaded tab moved off its restore mode, the test first asserts that the content's bucket differs from the restore mode's bucket, then that `arena_context`'s buckets and `flow_key` use that mode's bucket, and a descriptor-only lookup fails that test; for each tab kind, the descriptor-resolved bucket equals the loaded content's `context.er_dir` in the restore mode, the local PR tab having a git remote that resolves its owner and repo (with none, `TabIdentity::managed_root` falls through to the local view bucket, `crates/er-engine/src/tab_identity.rs:407`–`:409`, and `review_bucket_name` maps `Pr` to `branch`, `:294`–`:301`, so the PR Diff and Branch buckets are one directory), and the test first asserts that its PR Diff bucket differs from its Branch-view bucket; resolving every kind in Branch mode instead of the mode `resolve_descriptor` gives hands the local PR tab (restored on PR Diff) its branch view bucket and fails that test; an arena or flow context that reads `current_ai_effort` from the App fails the held-App-mutex test after a `set_ai_effort`.
- **Fallback split:** P60.1a the `jobs` aggregate and the arena; P60.1b review flows and the `App.svelte` listener.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
